title: Win a Napa Valley Getaway for Two at AAOE 2026
summary: Athelas will be at AAOE 2026 in Louisville, April 20 to 22, and one lucky visitor will get a chance to win a Napa Valley experience for two.
body_markdown:
**A Trip To Wine Country. On us.**


Athelas will be at AAOE 2026 in Louisville, April 20 through 22, and one lucky visitor will get a chance to win a Napa Valley experience for two.


**The Prize**


A complete Napa getaway for two, valued at up to $3,000, including:


- Round-trip airfare
- Hotel accommodations
- Wine tasting experience


**How to Participate**


- Visit the Athelas booth at AAOE Booth #211
- See a quick product demo with an Athelas team member
- Submit your contact info to be entered to win


**One demo. One entry. One chance at Napa.**


The winner will be randomly selected from eligible participants at the end of the conference and announced during AAOE’s Prize Event, Wednesday 4/22 at 12:30pm. Arrangements will then be made via contact information provided.


Additional Details: Must be 21+ and a registered conference attendee. Limit one entry per person. Full giveaway terms available at the Athelas booth.


‍


Find us at Booth #211. The coffee bar will be ready. So will your entry form.


Cut to: Care | Athelas
